title: Information disclosure through globally disabled enable-field evaluation
root_cause: The repository sets setIgnoreEnableFields(true) on its default query settings. Every query issued through this repository then bypasses the deleted, hidden, starttime and endtime restrictions, exposing restricted records to unprivileged callers.

origin.note: The published advisory states that information disclosure occurs, without naming the concrete code location. This fixture reproduces the class in an idiomatic Extbase repository; it is not a reconstruction of TYPO3 core code.
